notes.title: Glimpse of the Wild #3 – Into the Heart of Colorado
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Welcome to the third installment of our Glimpse of the Wild series!

Before diving into today’s topic, we’d like to extend a sincere thank you to all of you who have already added Hunting Simulator 3 to your Steam wishlist. Your support means the world to us. Wishlisting not only shows us that you're excited about the game, it also helps tremendously with visibility on the platform. If you haven’t done so yet, please consider adding it to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2482760/Hunting_Simulator_3/

[h3]Exploring Colorado[/h3]
In this update, we're taking you behind the scenes of the Colorado map, one of the key environments in Hunting Simulator 3.

Our primary goal in developing this region was ambitious: to recreate a natural space that feels authentic and immersive. We wanted Colorado to reflect the richness and diversity of its real-world counterpart, from the high mountain peaks to the rolling grasslands.

To achieve this, our team leaned heavily on reference materials (real-world photos, satellite imagery, and documentary footage) to guide the creation of terrain, vegetation, lighting, and animal habitats. Every detail, from the layout of the hills to the distribution of flora, was designed with authenticity in mind.

Players exploring this map will encounter a variety of ecosystems, each with its own atmosphere and challenges:

[list][*] Alpine: Rugged, high-altitude zones with sparse vegetation and panoramic views.
[*] Turf Zones: Low-lying wetland areas, rich in animal tracks and perfect for slow, patient stalking.
[*] Lodgepole: Narrow, tall forests with limited visibility and excellent cover.
[*] Aspen: Known for their golden autumn foliage and hauntingly quiet ambiance.
[*] Grasslands: Open areas ideal for spotting prey from a distance.
[*] Shrubland: Transitional zones offering unique visibility and cover mechanics.
[*] Spruce Forests: Dense and darker regions requiring a more strategic approach to hunting.[/list]
Each biome not only changes the visual tone of the game but also alters the way you play. The landscape itself becomes a vital part of the hunting experience.

notes.title: Glimpse of the Wild #2 - Vehicles.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318353/f84888e3a31e239bfef62a4461cba292b9756282.png[/img]

Dear Hunters,

Welcome to the second edition of your monthly Steam News, [i]Glimpse of the Wild[/i].
After introducing the unique animals of the Colorado map (if you missed it, you can catch up [[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2482760/view/517447479138976361]here[/url]]), we’re thrilled to reveal a major new feature in [b]Hunting Simulator 3[/b]: vehicles.

As in [b]Hunting Simulator 1 and 2[/b], the maps in [b]Hunting Simulator 3[/b] will span tens of square kilometers, offering vast and immersive environments for you to explore freely. To enhance your experience, [b]we’ve added off-road vehicles to make traveling faster, more convenient, and more enjoyable[/b]. Say goodbye to the frustration of walking for hours to reach your destination!

At launch, you’ll have access to UTV and an SUV, which can be acquired in the in-game store and accessed from your garage.

Today, we’re excited to unveil the first models integrated into the game. These vehicles are still in their pre-alpha phase and are subject to changes before the final release. We’re also proud to announce partnerships with three major official brands: [b]Kawasaki[/b], [b]Polaris[/b], and [b]Ford[/b].

[b]Kawasaki - MulePro FX EPS LE[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318353/56ad46b6bd1042ef15959106db5ddc56897dca52.jpg[/img]
[b]Kawasaki - MulePro FXT 1000 LeRanch[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318353/1b86ee71c8d838e2805a6165cd884be0c24d8490.jpg[/img]  
[b]Kawasaki - Teryx S LE[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318353/f6aa626226b258da52b6783550e642ea5d0047bb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318353/8c1abf2221eccf6fdc0bb7f729ed0be06caf603a.jpg[/img]
[b]Polaris - Ranger EV[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318353/817727ec511f2c4ebcc7d343779b85cf6388f23b.jpg[/img]
Here’s your first look at the vehicles that will be available in the game. We can’t wait to showcase them in action through upcoming videos or screenshots. In the meantime, feel free to share your thoughts and feedback here on Steam or directly on our Discord server.

Stay tuned for more sneak peeks and exclusive content. While you wait, join our community on Discord and follow our official social media channels to stay updated on all things Hunting Simulator 3.

Happy hunting!

After revealing the first announcement trailer for [url=https://youtu.be/kdgO9IDeUxc]Hunting Simulator 3[/url], we’re excited to share a steady stream of screenshots and videos with you over the coming months. These will showcase the game’s animals, weapons, gear, dogs, vehicles, and even the maps you’ll explore.

Please keep in mind that all content we share is still a work in progress and may be subject to change before the game’s release.
